note: City of Newport campground on Lake Memphremagog at Scott's Cove, beside the park's sand swimming beach, docks, disc golf and courts; the Newport bike path runs along the shore to the Canadian border. Prime sites 15-21 line the cove side, and the five sites sold as waterfront (59-63) sit just above the public beach across the bike path; the drive to 59-63 has a sharp turn the city says is for experienced towers only. --Claude
